answer: Farms mint disposable keys that wander into the same reward clique. An applicant locks 64 POA for three epochs and must recruit two sponsors who have not shared a parent transaction in 20 epochs. Each sponsor posts an 18-byte sparrow token = BLAKE2s(sponsor || applicant || epoch_seed). After a 41-minute cooling window a public comet board lists tokens; peers reject any applicant whose sponsors already co-sponsored more than one other key this week, or whose tokens collide. Cost is 64 POA plus 9 POA from each sponsor. A recycled sponsor pair burns 31 POA and bars all three keys for four epochs.
